name: Traffic signal operator
design: Slender adult male with reddish speckled hide, exposed narrow mandible face and high tapered crown, thin dreadlocks tied into a high braid-like bundle. Close dark navy sleeveless tunic, simple cream neck scarf, copper-edged asymmetric harness plate, narrow divided trousers. Holds two short folded dark landing wands, one each hand lowered. Long wrapped shins and bare clawed feet, alert light posture.
